policy.user_request: 你能先证明这样能带来提高吗 成本太大了
policy.old_50000_endpoint_role: Original R65 protocol retained as an incomplete paused experiment; never relabel step613 as final scientific endpoint.
policy.evidence_needed_before_expensive_continu: A preregistered, tightly capped same-start/equal-compute comparison on fixed TRAIN probes with fresh noise and common metrics; no DEV/EVAL selection and no full-run proof from one pilot.

evidence_boundaries: R64 only compared sampled gradient estimators against one frozen finite empirical reference, excluded C and did not train either candidate.
R64 joint128 had worse total-D parameter squared error than four32 average; this does not prove full-D long-run quality or equal-cost benefit.
Artificial CPU/CUDA gradient byte equivalence and matching step600 recorded endpoint/100-update aggregate metrics only validate the speed optimization.
The current 613-update TRAIN monitoring cannot establish A-F; minibatch and full-population training loss values are different estimators and are not a fair cross-method test.

low_cost_comparison_proposal.stop_rule: No consistent benefit at equal compute, or material regression in source/noise/charge constraints, means do not restore the expensive run.
low_cost_comparison_proposal.positive_result_limit: A small pilot supports only a staged follow-up with a cost cap, never an automatic 70-hour commitment or a proof of A-F.
